ios.desc:
How much do you actually drink in a week? Most people can't say, the count slips away between Tuesday and Saturday.
Tallyist gives you an honest picture, without the lecture. Log a drink in two taps. Beer, wine, spirits, or anything else. Pick a size, and Tallyist does the math for you. Adjust the details after if you want to, nothing blocks you from logging fast.

See your day, your week, your month. Just the numbers, no streaks, no scores, no judgment either direction.
Everything lives in Apple Health on your device. No account to create, no signup, nothing sold or shared.

Privacy Policy: https://tallyist.co/privacy/

quotes.text:
After a meeting with my doctor last year I started building an iOS drink tracker to get a better picture of how much I’m drinking.

It’s completely free and private and something I’ve enjoyed working on.

Would love your feedback. Support for Apple Watch and Android are coming soon too.
